Zendesk and Intercom price and configure like enterprise software, while plain Gmail collapses once two people answer the same inbox.

That’s why we built ReplyDeck: a shared support inbox that drafts replies in your team’s actual voice by learning from your resolved conversations. No training docs or scripting needed.

It cuts first-response time by 40% on average and sets up in five minutes by forwarding your existing address—no workflow configuration. Teams of 2–10 use it to stay aligned without the bloat.

We’ve helped customers handling up to 20,000 tickets/month scale support predictably at $29/seat/month, every feature included.
